summary: Midera Food Processing (indirect wholly owned by Middleby) filed an 8-K announcing a $1.0B credit agreement with Bank of America in connection with its anticipated spin-off into an independent publicly traded company. The credit facility comprises a $750M USD revolver and a $250M multicurrency revolver, with potential accordion features. The spin-off (not yet completed) must occur within 15 business days of closing, or commitments terminate. The borrower will become a direct subsidiary post-spin. Watch for spin-off consummation and the company's leverage profile; risk-arb centers on timing and execution of the separation.
